note: Read 2026-10-30. The Ley de Ingresos del Estado de Jalisco for the fiscal year 2026 (decree 30121/LXIV/25, the Congress's copy dated 24 Feb 2026) charges, under article 23 (services of the Secretaría de Transporte and others), $913.00 for the issue of a car driver's (automovilista) licence valid four years, $766.00 for its renewal (refrendo) for four years, and $557.00 for six months or $1,143.00 for a year of a minor's driving permit; the issuing fee is held. The Ley de Movilidad y Transporte del Estado de Jalisco (read in the 2013 law's copy published by the state's transparency site, last reform shown 20 Dec 2014) classes the automovilista licence (art. 56), asks the applicant to be over eighteen save where the law provides otherwise (art. 57), issues licences and renewals for four years (art. 62), and lets a person over sixteen and under eighteen have a permit, not a licence (art. 63); the four years are the 2026 tariff's own, and the age is that copy's, with the 2026 tariff still charging minors for a permit. The Secretaría de Transporte issues the licence (art. 54 of the same law, the Secretaría being the one the law names, and the tariff's article 23). The minor's permit, the renewal and the discounts aren't held.
